responsibility: Implements the core handwritten Epiphany backend logic and target hooks that are not encoded directly in the machine description. This file initializes targetm hooks for calling convention, argument passing, register usage, addressing, reloads, costs, vectorization, mode switching, trampolines, thunk emission, prologue/epilogue expansion, alignment, and asm output; it also contains target-specific helpers for long calls, interrupt and forwarder attributes, special function entry stubs, C++ MI thunks, and FP mode handling. In practice it is the central behavioral implementation file for the Epiphany port that connects GCC middle-end/RTL infrastructure to the target ISA and ABI.
same_name_distinction: This is the handwritten C++ implementation file for the Epiphany port: it supplies executable target-hook logic and helper routines that use definitions from the sibling files, rather than declaring configuration macros like epiphany.h, describing RTL instruction patterns like epiphany.md, or defining -m option metadata like epiphany.opt.
